voice.welcome: Welcome to Snack Math! These are adding stories, where we bring snacks together. Choose a picnic game.
voice.guided-intro: Listen to the story. Then tap the new snacks to add them to the tray.
voice.counter-intro: Tap each new snack to add it to the tray. Then choose how many there are altogether.
voice.picnic-intro: Make your own picnic. Choose a snack, then tap either side of the tray.
voice.stage-hint: Tap the new snacks to bring them to the tray.
voice.counter-hint: Tap each waiting snack, one at a time.
voice.how-many: How many snacks are there altogether?
voice.picnic-empty: Choose a snack, then tap either side of the tray.
voice.picnic-full: Your tray is full. Tap a snack on the tray to make room.
voice.complete-guided: You solved every snack story. What a wonderful addition picnic!
voice.complete-counter: You counted every snack. Your addition picnic is complete!
